$comment: Proof-row claims (appendix §6). A claim renders on production only when substantiated is true and evidence says why. On previews unsubstantiated claims render with a data-unsubstantiated attribute so the layout can be reviewed. Flip a flag only with evidence. The six from the proof-points document (recovery within 90 minutes, answered within 1 minute, lifetime guarantee, BS 10125 and new parts, updates your way, no cut of the settlement) are gated the same way.

claims.text: On average we answer the phone within 1 minute
New parts. Repairs to BS 10125 standards.
Updates your way: WhatsApp, email or phone
claims.note: Renders when the channel preference can be honoured consistently.
